card.name: Words just before clotting or blood-cell terms
card.fires_on: Words in blood-disorder warnings that sit right before a term such as thrombosis, disease or tablets. Seen on 'vein' in portal vein thrombosis, the end of hydroxyurea and clopidogrel, and 'liver' in chronic liver disease.
